dedupe_keys.name: portugal city emergency response infrastructure counts and geospatial inputs

description: This deposit counts hospitals, police offices, fire stations and rail or metro stations in Portuguese cities. João Paulo Just Peixoto and collaborators combine official city boundaries with OpenStreetMap infrastructure to provide national and city GeoJSON files, city OSM extracts, a summary CSV and generation scripts. Mendeley version 4 publishes data and script archives free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is cities across Portugal; a common extraction date was not established from the reviewed metadata. Facility counts describe a snapshot, not staffing, equipment readiness, response times or guaranteed emergency capacity. OpenStreetMap completeness and boundary choices are further limitations. Modellers could combine the locations and counts with hazards or demand to simulate access to emergency services. data-openstreetmap is an identified source, and data-portugal-nhs-hospitals-r-package provides related hospital information with different definitions. No archive was downloaded, the scripts were not run and the facility counts were not interpreted as validated response performance.
name: Portugal city emergency-response infrastructure counts and geospatial inputs
